gaps.concept: Reading an attached database's log and storage configuration
gaps.reason: XTDB 2.1.0 keeps it only in the primary database's log and block files (db_catalog.clj, block.proto); no query or HTTP endpoint returns it. Owner decision 2026-10-31: offer it at create only, labelled as not readable afterwards

gaps.concept: Renaming or changing an attached database
gaps.reason: XTDB 2.1.0 has ATTACH and DETACH only

fields.label: Database name
fields.help: Attach and detach run on the primary xtdb database. Attached databases are listed from SHOW SNAPSHOT_TOKEN, which names every one (pg_database shows only the connected database).

fields.label: Log and storage configuration (YAML, create only)
fields.help: Set once, at attach: XTDB never returns it, so CDEadmin cannot show it afterwards. Paths are on the XTDB server. Leaving log or storage out keeps it in memory, and its data is lost when the server restarts. Detach leaves the files; attaching the same paths again reopens the old data. After a restart, an attached database returns only once the primary log has been replayed, which can be after the server reports ready.

fields.label: Primary database
fields.help: The primary xtdb database cannot be detached.

fields.label: Attached databases not read
fields.help: Why only the connected database is shown.

notes: Hand-written for providers/xtdb/client.py and providers/xtdb/basis.py. The post-state check reads the snapshot token: an attached database must be listed, a detached one must not. Attach (in memory) and detach passed a live round trip on 2.1.0 (2026-10-31). Owner decision 2026-10-31: the configuration is offered at create only, labelled as not readable afterwards; the name and the attach itself are read back.
